sections.title: Introduction to Caries Risk Assessment
sections.description: This course provides students with GRD experience in order to gain additional knowledge, skills and values to develop competency in caries risk assessment. Classes are scheduled for the summer for the incoming second year and include the following topics: risk assessment for caries, health promotion care, and Axium. Students will be completing caries risk assessment in the simulation lab and record the completion of procedures in Axium using appropriate codes to document completion of required activities.
